catalysts.description: ACME launches its next-generation data-center GPU
ACME announces a new share buyback
ACME acquires a smaller chip-design company

articles.headline: ACME unveils next-gen data-center GPU at its developer conference
articles.summary: ACME announced its next-generation data-center GPU at the event, saying it will ship to customers this quarter.

articles.headline: Report: ACME could reveal a new data-center chip soon
articles.summary: Analysts speculated ACME may unveil a new data-center accelerator in the coming months, though nothing is confirmed.

articles.headline: ACME board authorizes $10 billion share buyback
articles.summary: ACME's board approved a new $10 billion share repurchase program, effective immediately, alongside quarterly results.

articles.headline: ACME in talks to acquire chip-design startup, sources say
articles.summary: People familiar with the matter said ACME is in early talks to acquire a smaller chip-design firm; no deal has been signed.

articles.headline: ACME completes acquisition of chip-design firm Volt
articles.summary: ACME said it has completed its acquisition of Volt, a small chip-design company, which is now a wholly owned subsidiary.

articles.headline: ACME raises dividend and expands repurchase program
articles.summary: ACME raised its dividend and expanded its share repurchase authorization, the company said in its results.

articles.headline: Federal Reserve holds interest rates steady
articles.summary: The Federal Reserve left its benchmark interest rate unchanged, citing mixed inflation data.

articles.headline: Semiconductor stocks rally on continued AI demand
articles.summary: Chip stocks broadly rose as investors bet on sustained demand for AI infrastructure.

articles.headline: ACME shares hit a 52-week high
articles.summary: ACME shares reached a 52-week high in Tuesday trading amid a broad market rally.

articles.headline: Analyst raises ACME price target to $220
articles.summary: An analyst raised the price target on ACME, citing strong end-market demand, and kept a buy rating.

articles.headline: Rival chipmaker posts record quarterly revenue
articles.summary: A competing chipmaker reported record revenue, beating estimates on data-center strength.

articles.headline: ACME CEO discusses long-term vision at industry summit
articles.summary: At an industry summit, ACME's chief executive spoke about the company's multi-year strategy and AI ambitions in general terms.

articles.headline: Global chip supply chains show signs of easing
articles.summary: Industry data suggested semiconductor supply constraints continued to ease across the sector.

articles.headline: ACME named to a sustainability index
articles.summary: ACME was added to a widely tracked sustainability index in its latest reconstitution.

articles.headline: Tech sector leads market higher
articles.summary: Technology shares led major indexes higher, with chipmakers among the gainers.

articles.headline: ACME opens a new engineering office
articles.summary: ACME said it opened a new engineering office and plans to hire across hardware and software teams.

articles.headline: Options activity picks up in ACME ahead of earnings
articles.summary: Traders noted elevated options volume in ACME in the run-up to its quarterly report.

articles.headline: Industry group publishes new interconnect standard
articles.summary: A semiconductor industry group published an updated interconnect standard for accelerators.

articles.headline: ACME partners on a university research grant
articles.summary: ACME said it is funding a university research grant focused on chip-cooling techniques.

articles.headline: Currency swings weigh on multinational tech earnings
articles.summary: Analysts said currency movements could pressure reported earnings for large multinational technology firms.
